evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies httpserver, bitcoin-cli, and RPC connection and binding options.
rationale: Resolves long-standing user request #5029 from 2014 by adding UNIX domain socket support to the HTTP RPC server and bitcoin-cli. This eliminates the need for TCP loopback connections and IP allowlists for local IPC, allowing operators to rely on OS filesystem permissions.
